job_to_be_done: Translate a short text string into a target language using DeepL so the agent can rewrite user-provided content across languages.
summary_for_model: Translates a single text string with DeepL. Source language is auto-detected; caller supplies `target_lang` (e.g. EN, JA, EN-US). Returns translated text plus detected source language and provenance fields.
trigger_conditions: The user asks to translate a sentence, paragraph, or message into another language.
The agent needs a high-quality translation for user-provided text and the target language is known.
do_not_use_when: The user is asking for cultural/idiomatic rewriting rather than a translation (use a writing tool instead).
The text contains sensitive secrets (API keys, passwords).

target_lang.description: DeepL target language code (e.g. EN, JA, DE, EN-US, PT-BR).

preserve_formatting.description: When true, DeepL tries to preserve formatting (punctuation/casing/newlines) more strictly.

split_sentences.description: Sentence splitting behavior: '1' (default), '0' (no splitting), or 'nonewlines' (split but keep newlines).

formality.description: Formality preference for the translation when supported by the target language.

summary.description: One-line summary of the translation performed.

detected_source_lang.description: Detected source language code reported by DeepL (may be null in unexpected cases).

target_lang.description: Target language code used for translation.

billed_characters.description: Number of source characters billed by DeepL for this request (when available).

source_url.description: Canonical DeepL API documentation URL for citation.

fetched_at.description: ISO timestamp for when this translation was performed.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Cache TTL in seconds (0 for this adapter).

attribution.description: Attribution string for the upstream provider.

notes_for_model: Use this tool only for translation. Keep the user’s intent and tone; do not add new information.
If the user wants localization (tone change, marketing rewrite), ask whether to adapt style rather than literal translation.
common_errors: `invalid_input` — missing `text` or `target_lang`, or invalid option types.
`upstream_unavailable` — DeepL API error or invalid/blocked API key.
